# Copilot Instructions - Shared Bundle

Scope: This repository only (my-dashboard-backend/shared-bundle).

## Rules

- Treat this package as a reusable internal library.
- Keep public APIs stable and backward-compatible unless explicitly changed.
- Prefer small, composable abstractions and strict typing.
- Avoid coupling this package to one concrete service.

## Quality

- Keep package metadata and autoload configuration consistent.
- Document breaking changes explicitly in commit or PR notes.
